messages:
Rhea (SRE): Postmortem follow-up: this thread is the accountability rollcall for all DR remediation items. I split into independent tickets; reply with "owner | ETA | acceptance" only so we can import into the closure board. Keep replies short.

Rhea (SRE): Items: 1) routing weight & automatic fallback validation; 2) nightly cross-region snapshot restore + checksum; 3) restore playbook: add KV priming + sanity checks; 4) rehearsal checklist + attendee rotation; 5) signal feed for recurring incident patterns (triage handoff).

Isaac (Net): Isaac | 2026-04-09 | routing harness merged + canary run proves automatic fallback within 45s for test-prefix; DONE when net-pr link + passing job in CI. Blocker: need ephemeral test prefix (net-sa access).

Priya (Backups): Priya | 2026-04-03 | nightly restore job in staging with checksum verification and sample read validation; DONE when 7 consecutive nightly runs pass. Blocker: object-store timeouts in eu-west (ticket BACK-902).

Omar (Oncall): Omar | 2026-03-30 | runbook PR with explicit KV priming step (synthetic warmup) and a traffic-gate checklist; DONE when PR merged and included in game-day invite. No blockers.

Lian (Platform PM): Lian | 2026-04-18 | rehearsal playbook + rotation schedule and war-room template published; DONE when invites sent and war-room doc has owner roster + rollback decision tree. Blocker: need calendar space confirmation from ops scheduling.

Rhea (SRE): Ops rule: all PRs must include the label `dr-closure-2026` and a single-line acceptance criteria in the body: owner | ETA | acceptance | rollback. I'll reconcile the closure board weekly.

Isaac (Net): test command for canary (WIP):

```
# run routing canary: fail primary region, assert redirect within 45s
./routing-canary --prefix test-failover-01 --fail-region us-east-1 --assert-redirect 45s --dry-run
```

Priya (Backups): restore cron we will deploy in staging:

```
# nightly restore at 02:15 UTC
15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/restore --snapshot latest --cluster staging --verify checksums --report /tmp/restore-report.json
```

Omar (Oncall): KV priming snippet for runbook: synthetic warmup hitting top-10 keys for 8m at 200 rps, then sanity GETs for traffic-gate. TTL in staging: 48h.

Lian (Platform PM): I added a template slide for the ops review: status | ETA | blockers | link. Will populate from closure board.

Isaac (Net): NET-TICKET created for ephemeral prefix & net-sa access: NET-4055. tagging @netops for expedite.

Priya (Backups): BACK-902 updated with object-store trace logs; requesting priority bump. I started a trimmed restore and attached logs to BACK-902.

Omar (Oncall): PR opened: https://git.redwood/runbooks/PR-5123 - explicit KV priming + warmup. Reviewers: Rhea, Lee.

DevOps Bot: Created task DR-CLOSE-2026-01: weekly closure reconciliation. Next run: 2026-03-29.

Rhea (SRE): For acceptance gating: each owner must provide a smoke test command or CI job name in the PR body. That will be used to auto-verify before I mark DONE.

Isaac (Net): Can we include a --no-impact mode for the canary so that DNS+BGP toggles are simulated without touching prod routes? I'll add a --simulate flag.

Priya (Backups): backup note: when we do sample restores, we should redact PII and run on a scrubbed dataset. adding step to BACK-902.

Lian (Platform PM): calendar hold created: "DR Rehearsal t: Closure run" on 2026-04-18. I'll push invites after NET-4055 is resolved.

Omar (Oncall): ran a local run of the restore playbook against a restore copy; found a missing step where KV priming didn't wait for migration completion. Logged in PR comments. Will update ETA if needed.

Rhea (SRE): update: Omar, keep it to PR comments and tag me. If migration wait adds >48h work, escalate.

Isaac (Net): NET-4055 resolved (access granted). pushing routing harness PR this afternoon.

Priya (Backups): nightly restore started in staging; first run failed due to object-store read timeout (BACK-902). triage scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT.

Lian (Platform PM): small ask: include the rehearsal runbook link in calendar invite and add an ack checkbox for each attendee (so we can track confirmations).

Rhea (SRE): final operational note: owners, add your ticket/PR link in the closure board and update status by Friday COB. I'll post a one-line follow-up in #incidents-summary each Monday until all items are DONE.

DevOps Bot: Reminder set: weekly update required in channel #incidents every Mon 09:00 UTC.

Priya (Backups): noted. BACK-902 updated with additional logs; will aim to have checksum parity by 2026-04-03.

Omar (Oncall): PR updated with migration wait and explicit priming loop. ready for review.

Isaac (Net): PR: https://git.redwood/net/PR-5198 - routing harness (WIP). reviewers: Rhea, Priya.

Rhea (SRE): thanks everyone. re-open thread if blockers persist. I'll close the closure board item when all DONE conditions are met. :white_check_mark:
